title: Choir Vault Ascension: Threshold Sign
description: Choir Vault Ascension unfolds across upper choir gate where song, law, and Hollow silence collide, pushing a 5-Titan Empyrean squad to prove protection, order-locks, shields, anti-chaos control, formationless aura play. without violating established Realm canon.
lore: Choir Vault Ascension: Threshold Sign advances Empyrean Choir Vault: The Radiant Hierarchies ascend a broken heaven-engine where order can stabilize worlds or erase dissonant survivors. It directly tests the faction tension: Their mercy is real, but so is their judgment. Allies fear becoming evidence in an Empyrean trial.
terrain: upper choir gate where song, law, and Hollow silence collide

objectives.primary: Secure the The Choir-Axiom Gate approach before Hollow pressure rewrites the field.
optional: Keep at least four Titans standing
Trigger at least two Empyrean faction mechanics

enemyWaves.entry: emerge through angelic order pressure fractures
reinforcement from the Gate wound flank

specialRules: Choir Lock: beacon timing shields formation if objectives resolve in order.
Radiant Edict: structured actions reduce chaos effects and protect allies.
victoryConditions: Secure the The Choir-Axiom Gate approach before Hollow pressure rewrites the field.

stars.one: Primary completed under severe casualty or turn pressure

squadDesignNotes: Balanced for the standard 5-Titan squad; special future modes may override team size explicitly.
